content.title: Recurring Route Reveals | Full Occlusions Relay Original Reaction Tableaux
content.summary: Use one recurring travel route as the visual refrain, and let complete moving occlusions reveal a sequence of materially different, fully original adult reaction tableaux in one fixed reveal zone. Return to the same route between scenes so the montage remains legible, then end on a complete final reaction rather than a borrowed meme likeness.

quick_start.input_format: recurring travel route + fixed reveal zone + complete moving occlusion + distinct original adult reaction tableau per reveal + route reset between scenes + complete terminal reaction
quick_start.recommended_input: A signal-yellow autonomous tram repeats the same turn around a rain-dark civic plaza. Each full tram-body wipe reveals a new group of clearly adult municipal workers in the same marked loading bay: a survey team recoiling from a harmless burst of blue foam, two gardeners silently celebrating a perfectly opened metal flower, and a courier ensemble frozen around a floating parcel compass. Return to the identical tram turn between each tableau and finish on the complete courier reaction as the compass settles into one hand.
required_anchors: Establish one recurring route and one repeatable reveal zone before the first tableau.
Use a physically motivated object to create a complete visual occlusion before every reveal.
Return to the same route between tableaux while preserving direction and environmental anchors.
End on a fully readable original reaction with no unfinished wipe.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Use one recurring travel route as the visual refrain, and let complete moving occlusions reveal a sequence of materially different, fully original adult reaction tableaux in one fixed reveal zone. Return to the same route between scenes so the montage remains legible, then end on a complete final reaction rather than a borrowed meme likeness.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one recurring transit route as the connective carrier. Use a fully motivated moving occluder to replace that route with one self-contained original reaction tableau in a fixed reveal zone. Give each tableau a different adult cast, prop family and single readable relationship change, hold it briefly, then restore the same route before the next reveal. End on a completed original reaction rather than a partial wipe. The reusable mechanism is recurring-route continuity, motivated occlusion, distinct tableau revelation and reaction closure—not any source meme, recognizable likeness, exact pose, city block, taxi, vehicle interior, food gesture, wardrobe, timing, watermark, creator identity or model label.

invariants.rule: Establish one recurring route and one repeatable reveal zone before the first tableau.
invariants.purpose: Provides connective geography for otherwise separate situations.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated establishing shots turn the result into an ordinary compilation.

invariants.rule: Use a physically motivated object to create a complete visual occlusion before every reveal.
invariants.purpose: Makes each replacement attributable and hides the spatial handoff cleanly.
invariants.ablation_failure: An arbitrary cut loses the route-based montage grammar.

invariants.rule: Give every tableau one distinct adult cast, prop family and readable relationship change.
invariants.purpose: Prevents the sequence from repeating the same joke with cosmetic swaps.
invariants.ablation_failure: Copying familiar poses or reusing the same interaction becomes imitation rather than a reusable system.

invariants.rule: Return to the same route between tableaux while preserving direction and environmental anchors.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the montage legible as one relay rather than disconnected sketches.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing the street axis or travel direction removes connective continuity.

invariants.rule: End on a fully readable original reaction with no unfinished wipe.
invariants.purpose: Provides a terminal payoff and a countable final state.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending during transit leaves the last tableau unresolved.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all recognizable source meme tableaux, public likenesses, facial identities, signature poses and reaction timing
the source city block, storefronts, taxis, road vehicles, car interior and repeated urban route
the source phone, cup, red-dress glance tableau, child passenger reaction, food-service gesture and yellow-shirt reaction
the source wardrobe, prop colors, camera positions, transition cadence and exact scene order
the source creator identity, Seedance 2.5 claim, platform overlays, watermark and any visible branding

instantiations.concept: An autonomous museum cart crosses the same glass gallery corridor and uses its passing body to reveal three original adult visitor tableaux: a conservator notices a reversed label, two architects exchange a folded model, and a guard catches a rolling audio guide; every tableau clears back to the same corridor before a final surprised acknowledgment hold.
